title:
You may remember in December 24, we started our latest fundraising venture ‘Everyone deserves cake’ our aim was to buy every tenant we support a Birthday card, cake and present over a 12 month period! 

We can now very proudly announce we have reached our target… From 1st January we will be fulfilling our promise to the tenants we support 🫶❤️

We can’t wait to share all these lovely Birthdays with you!

Also look out for our new fundraiser in 2026 

#bluepitshousingaction #SupportWork
